In the owned clone and original owning context, use public Restore Main Rig and authenticate successful recovery.
Create a distinct owned Scene and a complete independent native-ID fork of the recovered original Rig, data and necessary controller/constraint/skin dependencies; this is not an empty imported Rig.
Authenticate old Scene, nine rows, all original Actions/slots/motion hashes and old Rig native graph unchanged by fork construction.
Remap or remove legacy Scene/Rig/Action-session/Link identity references only on new owned IDs; do not edit original IDs or invent new WorkIDs.
Prove fork structural Rest/skin/constraints/controllers/colors/collections equivalent and no foreign mutable dependency points back to original Rig.
Select authenticated fork as Main Rig in its empty new worklist, then public Connect -> Use Main Rig -> Add -> Activate with actual prepared inputs.

Only after real tests use official Sync/worker and independent Unity Base/Target Apply; fork success does not itself prove formal original Scene/Rig integration.
